product_metadata.title: Nucookery Large 17 Oz Gravy Boat and Tray | Ergonomic Handle | White Fine Porcelain Saucier With Big Dripless Lip Spout For Gravy, Warming Sauces, Salad Dressings, Milk | Microwave & Freezer Safe
features: ENHACE THE TASTE OF FOOD IN SECONDS: If you are looking for a beautiful yet multifunctional gravy boat with tray, then we got you covered. Designed with your best interest at heart, this sauce bowl, is not just a Christmas must! You can use to it ameliorate the taste of your food, add a classy touch on the table and make everybody wonder! No more dull tasting meals or desserts thanks to this cute gravy boat!

NO MORE COUNTERTOP STAINS & LINEN MESS: No matter how thick or juicy, spicy or light your gravy is, we can assure you that this bowl won’t create a mess on the table. All of our gravy boats are meticulously designed to have a big lip! The convenient pour spout will perform dripless serving every single time! Give it a try and see the difference for yourself! Goodbye sticky stains on your favorite lace tablecloths!

EASY TO HOLD & NO MESS DESIGN – NEVER STRAIN YOUR HANDS AGAIN: Forget all about cheaply made gravy bowls that are way too small to accommodate all of your holiday needs! Invest in this large 17-Ounce (500ml) capacity boat and find that peace of mind you were looking for. The ergonomic handle will facilitate the holding and carrying to the fullest! So long tired hands and wrist fatigue from this day on! leave your gravy boat on the matching saucer and don't need to worry about it might spill.

MICROWAVE SAFE WHITE GRAVY BOAT: One of the greatest things about this gravy bowl, besides its fine porcelain design and large capacity, is its microwavable nature! Warm any type of gravy you want in the microwave oven without worrying about the porcelain cracking! You can place our saucier in the freezer for gravy storage as well! When you are done using, simply toss it in the dishwasher and let it do the rest!

SO MUCH MORE THAN A GRAVY SAUCIER: Made from outstanding porcelain, this gravy boat will surely compliment any kitchen! Don’t use this handy crockery only for Christmas holidays and Thanksgiving! It’s ideal for everyday use as well! Place inside sauces, salad dressings, broth, meat gravy, cheese dips and anything else that comes in mind! Pleasantly surprise your guests the next time you have them over for dinner!
